code='def transform(grid):\n    h=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=0]\n    w=len(grid[0])\n    v=[j for j in range(w) if len({r[j] for r in grid})==1 and grid[0][j]!=0]\n    def keep(n, lines):\n        out=[]; last=0\n        for x in lines:\n            if x>last: out.append(last)\n            out.append(x); last=x+1\n        if last<n: out.append(last)\n        return out\n    return [[grid[i][j] for j in keep(w,v)] for i in keep(len(grid),h)]\n'
